Yes, use them. If your back is the target and your grip quits first, straps let the back get the work it's actually there for.

A good way to run it is to go without straps for your warm-ups and lighter sets so your grip keeps getting trained, and strap up for the heavy top sets or high-rep work. A double overhand grip is also worth trying before you reach for a mixed grip. Only go to straps when the grip is the thing stopping the set.

The exception is if you're competing in something that bans them. Otherwise it's a sensible tool, not a crutch.
